question: Does fixed cubic information help a continued strong BRE base beyond adapted affine/quadratic controls, or is its apparent value specific to the old frozen base?
objective: Raw CE, frozen base plus half new head correction, fit-only centered/unit-RMS features. Report raw and quarter-search metrics; no model exported.
trigger: Native degree arms fail to beat adapted affine and continued BRE in closed development screens. Investigate the old-anchor dependency before proposing another architecture or training gate.
selection: All six fixed arms and all four consumed evaluation halves, with adapted controls and no-fit degree masks; a positive pilot alone is not strength evidence or a new gate.
resource: One serial BelowNormal process, timeout300seconds, between match batches only.
